title: Matrix product small-bias seed
statement: Let $n,a,b\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $n>0$, $a>0$, and $2a\le b$, and let the requested bias be encoded by $a/b$. For a Boolean vector of length twice the field degree of this input, the matrix product small-bias seed is a vector in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, whose $i$th coordinate is the output bit of the deterministic small-bias algorithm at coordinate $i$, using the two seed components obtained from the Boolean vector.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean seed vector of length twice the input's field degree
